items.html: And this is what is said: 'everything is completed in this Hochma,' as I explained, that the upper bone clothed in it, and descended until the end of the degrees. And this is what is said: 'all of them You made with wisdom.' And it is found that just as the upper Hochma, the Concealed Brain, sealed the light and the bone, that it should not descend except through the hairs — and this is the beginning of the correction of the Atik, to conceal it in order that it be revealed, for its concealment is its revelation — so this Hochma sealed the light, that it should not be revealed except clothed in her; and it is the cause of the revelation and the beginning, and therefore it is called 'the beginning.'
